messages:
zoe_finance: Quick heads-up price-smoothing pilot proposal: small per-embedding adjustment paired with a smoothing window so customers don't see abrupt invoice jumps. Target pilot start 2026-09-14 08:00 UTC. Need invoice-preview, legacy-preserve exceptions, and comms.

miguel_billing: Sounds good. Please confirm cohort selection criteria (plan IDs + exclude flags). Also requesting an invoice flag `smoothing_experiment=true` on affected invoice lines for reconciliation.

dinesh_sales: We must exclude any customer with negotiated or fixed-price contracts. I'll pull a list of AM-owned accounts and flag those that want a pre-notice. No surprise billing.

anya_ops: Staging SQL for cohort extract (run in staging only):
```sql
SELECT s.id, s.customer_id, s.plan_id, c.tags, s.next_billing_date
FROM subscriptions s
JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.next_billing_date BETWEEN '2026-09-14' AND '2026-10-14'
  AND c.negotiated = false
  AND c.tags NOT LIKE '%enterprise%';
```
I'll run and upload CSV to /finance-drive.

miguel_billing: Running invoice-preview now: `./bin/invoice-preview --cohort price-smoothing-pilot --sample 120`

billing-bot: billing-bot: invoice-preview complete for cohort price-smoothing-pilot  120 samples uploaded: https://redir.company/samples/price-smoothing-pilot-preview.csv

miguel_billing: Preview shows 11 subscriptions with manual rate overrides and 4 with outstanding promo credits. For manual overrides I propose marking them `legacy-preserve` and issuing one-time balance adjustments rather than changing their rate. For promos we pro-rate remaining credit. Need sign-off.

zoe_finance: I support legacy-preserve for manual overrides. For the smoothing window: propose a 3-billing cycle ramp (33% change per cycle) with a hard cap of 10% net delta per invoice. If any customer would exceed cap, exclude and handle manually.

dinesh_sales: That cap helps AM conversations. I'll prepare an outreach batch for any accounts that would be in the manual pathway. Sophie, can legal OK the cap language?

sophie_legal: Reviewing. Two quick asks: (1) add explicit "no retroactive billing" clause in comms and (2) confirm we record agreement to smoothing in portal for any opted-in customers. I'll deliver approved text by Tue EOD.

anya_ops: Ops checklist: add rate mapping entry `price_smoothing_v1` -> `RC_SMOOTH_2026`, open PR to payments-service, and include dry-run: `make billing-migrate COHORT=price-smoothing-pilot DRY_RUN=1`. I'll include a migration smoke-test and preflight log link.

miguel_billing: Also requesting a new audit export `billing.audit.experiment_lines` that dumps invoice lines with `smoothing_experiment` and `applied_rate_id` for rapid reconciliation. Ops, can you enable in staging?

anya_ops: Yes, will enable export in staging and share path. Sample command: `./tools/audit-export --cohort price-smoothing-pilot --out /tmp/smoothing-audit.csv`

billing-bot: billing-bot: dry-run migration queued: `make billing-migrate COHORT=price-smoothing-pilot DRY_RUN=1`. Logs will be posted to the PR.

miguel_billing: Found 3 subscriptions tied to a legacy vendor pass-through credit (vendor_code XTR-9). Those need manual review because vendor billing may not accept partial pro-rate. Propose we mark them `vendor-review` and delay changes until vendor confirms.

zoe_finance: Agree to vendor-review hold. Miguel, prepare exception sheet with the following columns: sub_id, customer_id, reason (override|promo|vendor), proposed_adjustment, AM_owner, recommended_action. Post to rollout doc and we'll triage in preflight.

dinesh_sales: I'll start AM outreach list once exceptions sheet is up. Planning targeted emails 72h prior to pilot start for manual cases.

sophie_legal: Posting comms with "no retroactive billing" language and opt-out link. Also adding a one-line FAQ about smoothing and vendor credits. See draft in rollout doc.

zoe_finance: Canary schedule suggestion: 2% invoice volume first 12h -> 15% next 48h -> 50% days 4-7 -> full at day 10 if stable. Rollback triggers: >3% revenue variance in 24h, >0.8% billing ticket spike, any vendor disputes.

miguel_billing: Action items: run staging cohort (due 2026-09-01), produce exceptions sheet (due 2026-09-03), validate dry-run + audit export (due 2026-09-06). Preflight call 2026-09-10.

anya_ops: Will open PR for rate mapping and post dry-run logs. Also will enable audit export in staging and share link to CSV.

dinesh_sales: Noted. Will coordinate AM outreach and prepare email copy for manual exceptions.

zoe_finance: Thanks team. If no major blockers we aim for pilot start 2026-09-14 08:00 UTC with the smoothing ramp. Will post final go/no-go agenda 2026-09-12. :rocket:
